lines.text: Who are we if our creative work is stolen? What if we forget the greatest love of our lives? Amidst human secrets and betrayal, a badly burnt rescue dog provides a powerful connection, healing those around her through devotion, love, and atonement, even in the places of deep hurt. Aggie's Fiction Pick for October 2026
